verified_claims.claim: T1 纯合系 TSS-5/7/8/10 紫杉二烯产量依次为 22/13/27/11 µg/g dw
verified_claims.evidence: 原文: 'the TSS-5, 7, 8, and 10 homogene lines accumulated 22, 13, 27, and 11 µg taxadiene per gram of dried leaves, respectively (Fig. 4)'

verified_claims.claim: MJ 100 µM 处理使紫杉二烯从 TSS-8 对照 25 µg/g dw 提升至 35 µg/g dw（1.4 倍）
verified_claims.evidence: 原文: 'MJ treatment increased the accumulation of taxadiene to 35 µg/g of dried leaves from 25 µg/g in the control TSS-8 line (Fig. 6)'

verified_claims.claim: VIGS 沉默 PSY 使紫杉二烯升至 48 µg/g dw，相对 TSS-8 对照升高 93.58%（约 1.9 倍）
verified_claims.evidence: 原文: 'Silencing the N. benthamiana PSY gene and diverting the pathway for carotenoid biosynthesis resulted in accumulation of 48 µg taxadiene/g of dried leaves, which was 93.58 % higher than the control TSS-8 line (Fig. 6)'

verified_claims.claim: 沉默 PDS 使紫杉二烯相对 TSS-8 对照下降 47.59%
verified_claims.evidence: 原文: 'silencing of the PDS gene by VIGS decreased the accumulation of taxadiene by 47.59 % relative to the control TSS-8 line (Fig. 6)'

verified_claims.claim: T0 转化系中 TSS-2/3/5/6/7/8/10 共 7 株在 13.09 min 处出现与紫杉二烯质谱匹配的 GC 峰，产量 4–18 µg/g dw
verified_claims.evidence: 原文: 'seven independent T0 transformed lines, TSS-2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, and 10, showed a GC peak at 13.09 min (Fig. 3b), and the mass spectrum for the peak exactly matched with the mass spectroscopy profile of taxadiene (Fig. 3c)... producing 4–18 µg taxadiene per gram of dried leaves (Fig. 4)'

verified_claims.claim: 转化流程数量链：约 200 个愈伤组织 → 110 株独立转化系移植 → RT-PCR 整合验证后保留 14 株成功整合 TS 基因
verified_claims.evidence: 原文: 'Next, 200 calluses were obtained from the agro-infected leaf explants... A total of 110 transformed lines were subsequently transplanted to soil... Finally, the survived 14 transformed plants indicated the successful integration of the TS gene (Fig. 2)'

verified_claims.claim: PSY/PDS VIGS 构造片段长度分别为 198 bp / 369 bp，克隆入 pTRV2
verified_claims.evidence: 原文: 'a VIGS vector was constructed by insertion of 198 and 369 bp partial products of the PSY and PDS genes into pTRV2 vector, respectively (Fig. 5a, b)'

verified_claims.claim: TS 基因来源于 T. cuspidata，CaMV 35S 启动子驱动组成型表达，qPCR 扩增 216 bp 片段鉴定纯合系
verified_claims.source_locator: PDF 物理页 1 / 4, Abstract & Materials and methods
